# Ktorfit

# Introduction

Ktorfit is an HTTP client/Kotlin Symbol Processor for Kotlin Multiplatform (Js, Jvm, Android, iOS, Linux) using [KSP](https://github.com/google/ksp) and [Ktor clients](https://ktor.io/docs/getting-started-ktor-client.html) inspired by [Retrofit](https://square.github.io/retrofit/)
